content.title: DraftKings Shakes Off Revenue Hit, Enters Prediction Markets
content.summary: DraftKings said Thursday it would launch a prediction market for sports outcomes in coming months, potentially turning a competitive threat into a growth opportunity.  After cutting its full-year outlook amid bettor-friendly sports outcomes, DKNG stock fell to a two-year low early Friday before turning higher.  DraftKings CEO Jason Robins said in a letter to shareholders that "just a handful of NFL games had a pronounced effect" on revenue, with a hit of more than $300 million in September and October.
